title: Create request
intro: The lead becomes a client, the letter goes to the director in “Documents · Incoming letters”, a project chat is created.

client.searchHint: Similar clients — pick one to avoid a duplicate company
client.name: Company name

contact.name: Name
contact.channelsHint: At least one channel is required: Telegram, phone or email

summary.label: Request summary
summary.hint: What the client needs: items, volume, timing

letter.label: Letter addressed to the director
letter.hint: PDF, image or Office document up to 25 MB. Optional
letter.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB
letter.unsupported: PDF, image or Office document only

consent.missing: The client has not given consent yet.
consent.viaBot: A Telegram lead gives consent in the bot: ask them to press “I agree”.

consequence.lead: The lead becomes a client and you become responsible for the conversation; the bot keeps answering for this client.
consequence.request: A request with a ЗВ number appears in the back office.
consequence.letter: The letter goes to the director in “Documents · Incoming letters”{{urgent}}.

clientGets: The client gets: “Request ЗВ-… accepted, we are calculating” and an “Open portal” button — in Telegram or by email.
submit: Create request → to the director's Inbox

done.title: Request created
done.text: The request is going to the back office; the ЗВ number will appear on the client card.
done.repeated: This request has already been created — showing it.

errors.company: Pick a client or enter the company name
errors.contact: Pick a contact or enter a name
errors.channel: At least one channel is required: Telegram, phone or email
errors.consent: A request cannot be created without the client's consent
errors.handoff_no_consent: The client has not given data consent — record how it was received
errors.consent_via_bot: A Telegram lead gives consent in the bot — ask them to agree
errors.contact_channel_required: The contact has no Telegram, phone or email
errors.request_not_allowed: The lead is lost — a request cannot be created from it
errors.request_key_reused: The form is outdated — open “Create request” again
errors.erp_not_configured: The back office is not connected — contact the administrator
errors.telegram_linked_elsewhere: The lead's Telegram is already linked to another client
errors.letter_failed: The letter was not uploaded — remove it or pick another file, otherwise the request goes without it
errors.request_not_failed: The request is already being sent or was sent to the back office — refresh the card
errors.request_not_retryable: Retrying will not help: the request data changed after sending — create the request again
errors.enqueue_failed: Could not queue the sending — try again a bit later
errors.generic: Could not create the request. The form data is kept — try again
